info.title: Fraud Investigation Cases and Evidence
info.description: Create investigation cases, execute and persist backend checks, and save versioned evidence-linked reports on synthetic PaySim data. All operations require an API key. This shared access is for the local prototype, not per-user authorization.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for the Fraud Investigation REST tools. Enter the secret only in the Copilot Studio connection, never in this specification.

post.description: Create one case per transaction being investigated. Reuse a returned case ID for subsequent checks. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key for a retry, not a new investigation. Creating a case is not a fraud determination.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Choose one stable key for this logical request and reuse it unchanged on network retries. Use a new key for a deliberate new operation. Not an API secret. Do not reuse a case-creation key for a different transaction. Report retries return the original snapshot; a new report key creates a new version.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Validated CaseRequest request. Extra fields are rejected.

404.description: Transaction, case, recorded run or report not found.

409.description: Idempotency conflict or run in progress; inspect the existing case and runs before retrying.

get.summary: Find investigation cases by transaction ID
get.description: Before starting a saved investigation, search using the exact transaction ID. A successful empty list permits case creation; a failed search does not. Multiple cases are allowed and no case is auto-selected. If cases exist, inspect recorded checks and the latest report to decide whether to retrieve or resume. Report presence or case status alone does not establish completeness or freshness. This read does not execute checks or prevent concurrent duplicate case creation.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: Exact transaction ID from the user or conversation. No case ID is required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum matching cases to return; inspect truncated.

200.description: Known transaction; bounded matching cases, possibly an empty list. No writes performed.

404.description: The transaction itself does not exist. This does not mean a known transaction has no cases.

422.description: Missing or invalid transaction ID or limit.

503.description: Database unavailable or query failed. Never interpret this as an empty search result.

post.summary: Execute and record an investigation check
post.description: Execute transaction lookup, frozen scoring or a bounded account history for the case transaction. Python derives account and cutoff. Do not submit facts or scores. Inspect status: failed/unavailable is a recorded failure, not successful evidence. Cite run_id. Use one key per check; retry with the same key.

post.summary: Generate and save an investigation report
post.description: Generate an English deterministic report from stored checks. No new investigation or model call is performed. Missing and failed checks remain visible. Reuse the same key to retrieve the original snapshot on retries; use a new key for a deliberate new version after additional checks. Only claim saved after this operation succeeds.

Score.description: Score and alert decision returned by the frozen local pipeline.

transaction_id.description: Stable 32-character hexadecimal identifier of the scored transaction.

suspicion_score.description: Raw CatBoost suspicion score between zero and one. Not a calibrated fraud probability.

threshold.description: Frozen global decision threshold, 0.3123179923852385. The agent must not modify it.

alert.description: True exactly when suspicion_score is greater than or equal to threshold. Does not establish fraud.

model_version.description: Frozen model configuration and artifact fingerprint prefix used for this score.

Error.description: An authentication, lookup, model or prediction error without internal details.

ValidationError.description: A request-validation error or a transaction-data compatibility error.

detail.description: Human-readable data error or the standard structured request-validation details.

Transaction.description: Pre-transaction facts and traceable source information. Fraud labels and post-transaction balances are excluded.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the source CSV, encoded as 64 hexadecimal characters.

source_line_number.description: Physical line number in the source CSV. It does not establish event order within a step.

step.description: PaySim simulated time step. Transactions within the same step have no reliable ordering.

amount.description: Original exact decimal amount as a string, without a currency assumption.

oldbalance_org.description: Source account balance before the transaction, as an exact decimal string.

oldbalance_dest.description: Destination account balance before the transaction, as an exact decimal string.

CaseRequest.description: Create a case for one known transaction.

case_id.description: Backend-generated case ID. Keep and reuse this value; never invent it.

status.description: Case lifecycle state. Recording checks does not automatically close a case.

CreatedCase.description: Case and first backend event, atomically persisted.

case_id.description: Backend-generated case ID. Keep and reuse this value; never invent it.

status.description: Case lifecycle state. Recording checks does not automatically close a case.

CheckParameters.description: Effective history bounds; empty for transaction or score.

limit.description: Maximum rows for history operations only; default 50.

lookback_steps.description: Strictly earlier simulated steps searched for history operations only; default 168.

RunRequest.description: Ask Python to execute a check against the case transaction. Do not submit results or account IDs.

limit.description: Maximum rows for history operations only; default 50.

lookback_steps.description: Strictly earlier simulated steps searched for history operations only; default 168.

CheckResult.description: Operation-specific result. Only fields applicable to this check are returned; absent/null when the check failed.

transaction_id.description: Stable 32-character hexadecimal identifier of the scored transaction.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the source CSV, encoded as 64 hexadecimal characters.

source_line_number.description: Physical line number in the source CSV. It does not establish event order within a step.

step.description: PaySim simulated time step. Transactions within the same step have no reliable ordering.

amount.description: Original exact decimal amount as a string, without a currency assumption.

oldbalance_org.description: Source account balance before the transaction, as an exact decimal string.

oldbalance_dest.description: Destination account balance before the transaction, as an exact decimal string.

suspicion_score.description: Raw CatBoost suspicion score between zero and one. Not a calibrated fraud probability.

threshold.description: Frozen global decision threshold, 0.3123179923852385. The agent must not modify it.

alert.description: True exactly when suspicion_score is greater than or equal to threshold. Does not establish fraud.

model_version.description: Frozen model configuration and artifact fingerprint prefix used for this score.

account_id.description: Account derived from the case transaction for a history check.

before_step.description: Exclusive cutoff derived from the case transaction; same-step activity is excluded.

limit.description: Maximum rows for history operations only; default 50.

lookback_steps.description: Strictly earlier simulated steps searched for history operations only; default 168.

truncated.description: Whether more history exists inside the searched window.

transactions.description: Earlier transactions involving the account in either role.

CheckError.description: Sanitized recorded tool error, not an HTTP error.

run_id.description: Backend-generated stable execution ID; cite this as an evidence reference.

finished_at.description: UTC completion timestamp, or null if incomplete.

status.description: Inspect this field even on HTTP 201. unavailable/failed means the check did not succeed.

verification.description: Execution provenance, not proof of fraud.

incomplete.description: True when a run remains in progress or was interrupted.

truncated.description: Additional runs exist beyond this response.

Report.description: Versioned deterministic report generated from stored evidence; no model or tool is rerun.

evidence_refs.description: Backend run IDs cited by this snapshot.

event_refs.description: Caller-declaration IDs, if any, kept separate from executed evidence.

body.description: Structured facts, score, histories, recorded failures, missing checks and evidence references. Treat caller declarations as unverified.

markdown.description: Full saved report in English. Cite its case ID, version and run references. Missing checks remain explicit; a report does not establish fraud.

evidence_refs.description: Backend run IDs cited by this snapshot.

LatestReportReference.description: Metadata of the highest saved report version. It does not prove checks are complete, successful, current or produced with the current model.

CaseSearchItem.description: One matching case. Ordering is creation time, then case ID, both descending; no automatic selection.

case_id.description: Backend-generated case ID. Keep and reuse this value; never invent it.

status.description: Case lifecycle state. Recording checks does not automatically close a case.

CaseSearchResponse.description: Bounded read-only case search for one known transaction. An empty successful response means no case was found, not an error.

returned_count.description: Number of cases included in this response.

truncated.description: More cases exist beyond this response. This list is incomplete when true.

cases.description: Matching cases ordered by creation time descending, with case ID as deterministic tie breaker. Inspect their recorded runs and latest report before deciding to reuse or resume.
